$comment: VAPP-229 (spec docs/spec/apps.md §9.3, M3): EVERY row an app causes reads "via <app>" ×4. A nullable `via_app_id` (FK apps, ON DELETE SET NULL, SYNCED) sits on `comments` (#VAPP-186, its caption = reporter-reply.json `captions.viaApp`), `issues`, `sessions` and `app_records`. The SERVER stamps it, never a client: the apps broker (`/api/mcp/apps`) runs an app's exposed tool (`run.records` / `run.action`) and, later, its automations (A1) on a server-side context naming the app (apps/web lib/emcp/via-app.ts); issues.create, sessions.send (every session row it inserts: a new root, a child, an agent's fresh thread) and the records service's create stamp that app. An app's own UI writing through the viewer's client (records.*, exponential.* over /api/mcp) is the viewer's own write and carries none (a client cannot claim an app). `sessions.via_app_id` is NOT `sessions.app_id` (the app an EDITOR session edits). A record's `via_app_id` is set on CREATE only (an update keeps it). RESOLVE: the id against the client's synced, non-trashed apps; an unknown or deleted app = no caption (null). TEXT: `viaAppCaption(name)` = `copy.viaApp` with `{app}` = the name, null without a name (`captionCases`); `withViaApp(text, name)` = text + `copy.separator` + that caption, the text alone without one (`appendCases`). WHERE ×4 (existing text, no new component): ISSUE DETAIL = the activity timeline's synthesized creation row, its muted tail `created the issue · {time}` gets the caption appended (`withViaApp`, so `Ana created the issue · 2h · via Timesheet`); SESSION VIEW = one muted text-xs line under the header's title / origin row (`viaAppCaption`, absent without one; the thread header itself stays caption-free, session-thread.json); DATA TAB = the By cell (app-records.json `dataTab`) = `withViaApp(recordByline(...), name)` (`Ana · via Timesheet`, one truncated line; phones' rows carry no By cell). Mirrors: TS packages/domain-contract/src/via-app.ts, desktop domain::via_app, iOS ExpCore ViaApp.swift, Android domain/ViaApp.kt replay every case.

captionCases.name: an empty name reads as none

appendCases.name: issue creation tail without an app
a deleted app = the text alone
